name: version_sorter
description: Semantic-version parsing, precedence comparison (including pre-releases), sorting and caret/tilde/comparison range matching.
bugs: parse() keeps numeric pre-release identifiers as strings, so beta.11 sorts before beta.2
compare() compares release tuples without zero-padding, so 1.2 sorts before 1.2.0
satisfies() uses <= against the exclusive upper bound of caret/tilde ranges
